dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Drat... If only we had more manpower...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Traveler? Great timing! You've seen the tempests that Stormterror's kicked up in Mondstadt, haven't you?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: The Knights of Favonius have mobilized their full strength. Naturally, the Adventurers' Guild will not stand idly by. It is time for the people to witness our strength!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: The Knights are in charge of internal security, but those foolish monsters outside the city walls are the specialty of the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: The Guild's experienced hands have all been sent to various places to investigate. But... I just fear for Jack.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: He volunteered to go to the Thousand Winds Temple, but we haven't heard from him since.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I like his spirit, but he's too rash sometimes and doesn't have enough experience. I worry that something might happen to him.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Traveler, if you are willing, could you help me go to the Thousand Winds Temple to look for Jack?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure thing.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Thank you! I must oversee the situation here at the Guild, or I would have gone myself.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I am counting on you. The Guild must not lose another young soul.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There are other things I need to do...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: ...Alright. In such times, settling your own affairs is the wisest choice.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: The storms suddenly stopped...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that a bad thing?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, no... It's good that they stopped, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Hmm... But it's all too sudden. I came up with so many contingency plans. Are we not going to get the chance to any of them?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: My contingencies included ways to scatter the people in the wild to avoid the storms, teach them how to survive...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: ...We were going to teach them to set up basic camps, do pest control, avoid beasts and monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, never mind. Rather than take our chances out there, better to remain safe within these walls.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. Some of our investigating adventurers have informed me that there are monsters congregating in the Whispering Woods.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Almost everyone is out investigating, and I must remain here to command them.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Traveler, can I count on you to clear those monsters out?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Consider it done.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I will leave it to you, then. Don't worry, you will be compensated fairly!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem unhappy about this.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, this... Well, you know how the young people in Mondstadt all wish to join the Knights of Favonius, with their shining armor, their flying banners, the glory, and Master Jean as well...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: As for the Adventurers' Guild, the only impression of us people have is that of people who bumble about outdoors... Basically, no one cares about us.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I thought to myself that if there was an opportunity to show the Guild's mettle, we might be able to bring in more fresh blood.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, but it doesn't matter. The safety of Mondstadt is more important than my own personal wishes.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I'll leave those monsters to you. I'll have your compensation ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other matters...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Alright. Go get your affairs in order first. I'll think of a way to get someone to clear those monsters out.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: *sigh* Where has that kid Bennett run off to? I hope he didn't run into any trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Bah, Stormterror was defeated, just like that? We didn't even get the chance to take the stage...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Oh, if it isn't the Honorary Knight. The storms have ceased, and Stormterror has been defeated.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: This is a good thing, yes... But couldn't Stormterror have put up a bit more of a fight?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: And here I was thinking that after clearing the monsters surrounding the city out, we could select some elite adventurers to form a team of dragon hunters to challenge Stormterror!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: But just as we were having trouble finding a healer, Stormterror was defeated.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: We also need to help the citizens find cats and dogs, send meals and clean house... At this rate, we'll have lost our opportunity for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: *sigh* Let's leave that aside for now. I've heard from our scouts that there are still monsters wandering the Whispering Woods.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: But our forces are scattered throughout the wilds and cannot return, and I must handle some assorted matters.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Could I trouble you to go to the Whispering Woods and see to the situation there?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Thank you. I will be handling commissions here...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: A signboard blown away by the wind... Flowers blown away by the wind... A lost cat... *sigh* It is as I expected...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have other matters to handle...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah. Go about your business, then. Now that Stormterror has been vanquished, these things aren't so urgent...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Huh!? Jack has never fought like this before!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Hahaha! It looks like I'm pretty good at this!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Hmph. It's high time we took care of these crooks...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: When that storm from before had just appeared, the Knights and the Adventurers' Guild sprang into action.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: But as we were busy with evacuation and rescue work, it seems as though some Treasure Hoarders managed to sneak in amid the chaos.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: These thieves took advantage of that moment when we were stretched thin, and managed to steal quite a few things throughout the city.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Carrots from the Dawn Winery, Philanemo Mushrooms from Springvale, a stack of silverware from the Goth Grand Hotel... Hmph, they've even stolen some of the food stocked in the Good Hunter's larder.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: If it's not nailed down, these bandits will take it. Why, if this storm hadn't subsided so quickly, I doubt there'd be anything left in Mondstadt to steal.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: We've got enough hands on deck again, but looking for those things may prove very difficult. The speed at which they flee with their loot is only surpassed by their ability to fence it.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Still, we must make them pay.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Honorary Knight. If you're willing, would you like to have a little chat with those Treasure Hoarders?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wouldn't miss it for the world.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Good! A fine answer, worthy of your title.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Then I shall leave this matter to you. We have caught the trail of a group of Treasure Hoarders around the city. I will mark it down on your map.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: But they are a wily bunch. It would take you some effort to completely clear their camps out.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: But for an Honorary Knight like you, it should be a simple matter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd love to, but...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, is that so... It's fine. You are the Honorary Knight, after all, I should think that there are many other things that you have to attend to throughout the city.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you share some adventurer's experience with me?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Why, of course. Here, take this. I'm sure it'll be of use to you.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: ...To put it plainly, you need only remember two words... Courage and perseverance!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Hey, kiddo! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Hey, isn't it... you... You're here for the wine too?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I'm Cyrus, Master of the Adventurers' Guild, Mondstadt Branch!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I'm sure we'll get to know each other later on. I can tell you are a born adventurer!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: How can I tell? Just call it a senior adventurer's hunch, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Listen, if you're interested, we can talk about it some more at Angel's Share another day!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: We have branches all around Teyvat! Haha!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: You can meet fellow adventurers in the guild, participate in expeditions to every corner of the land, and get paid for completing commissions...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: This truly is heaven for all adventurers! You sure you're not interested, kid? Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: A youngster like you should be more energetic. Don't be cold!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Isn't that a sight to behold...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't you going to find shelter?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Haha, I'm made of sterner stuff than that! Sure it's been a while since I last went on an adventure, but I'm not Master of the Guild for nothing you know!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: There's not an adventurer alive that would want to miss out on a sight like this!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: This is exactly how Mondstadt is said to have looked in the early days, according to the legends...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: A crisis? I see this as the opportunity of a lifetime!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: If there is any adventurer who does not get their blood up at this, surely they fail as an adventurer!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Once the time is right, I must take Jack and the others out to see the world. And thanks to this incident, our adventure teams can be expanded a little, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: And as for the dragon... well, there isn't anything that cannot be conquered with perseverance, is there?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: What a showing from the Knights of Favonius! Most of them are youngsters without much combat experience, but they do have an adventurous spirit! Not bad. Not bad at all!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: If I had to criticize, then I would say that they do drag their feet a little, perhaps?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: If it was always their intention to send me an adventure commission, they really didn't have to take a whole day to decide that.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, I must be a little drunk... Well, it doesn't matter. What does matter is that I'm treating tonight!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are... the Master of the Adventurers' Guild, right?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Haha, you got a good memory.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: It's just a title, nothing more.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I only became some legendary adventurer for completing some top-tier commissions by chance.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: The real legends... are for you to create! Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your story.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: My story? What is there to tell?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Let's see... I slew three dragons, crushed two international pirate organizations, saved Teyvat once... Nothing major.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: ...Where was I? I think I'm getting a bit too tipsy...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me then.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: You leaving? Don't be such a stranger, haha!
